module: "Group" layer type of the Dynamic Decals tool: a container layer that groups other layers; disabling it hides all its children. This module adds the "Add group" button to the toolbar (api.addGroup), registers an empty inspector GUI for this type and the "Layer Types / Group Layers" documentation page.
notes: inspectLayerGui and sectionGui (exported under the name onGui) are empty functions: a group has no property of its own in the inspector beyond name and enabled.
The registration of the "Group Properties" section is commented out.

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: registers the inspector GUI of the group type, the "group" toolbar item (order 30) and the documentation page.
